sloka: कौशिको ऽथ यवक्रीतो गार्ग्यो गालव एव च ।कण्वो मेधातिथेः पुत्रः पूर्वस्यां दिशि ये श्रिताः ।। ७.१.२ ॥
transliteration: kauśiko 'tha yavakrīto gārgyo gālava eva ca ।kaṇvo medhātitheḥ putraḥ pūrvasyāṁ diśi ye śritāḥ ।। 7.1.2 ॥

translations.english: Kaushika, Yavakrita, Gargya, Galava, and Kanva, the son of Medhatithi, who resided in the eastern direction, also arrived.
